body:
> 5\. Within a few minutes, the Output panel fills with errors and the editor freezes or crashes

It seems you forgot to include these errors in the problem description. You can run Godot via the console to copy the errors.

1. The first error, when texture creation starts failing:
```
ERROR: Element limit reached.
   at: _allocate_rid (./core/templates/rid_owner.h:122)
```
On 4.7.1 the same error is worded Element limit for RID of type '…' reached.

2. The failures that follow it, as each texture fails to be created:
```
ERROR: Parameter "mem" is null.
   at: initialize_rid (./core/templates/rid_owner.h:284)
ERROR: Attempted to name invalid ID: 0
   at: set_resource_name (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:8053)
ERROR: Parameter "texture" is null.
   at: _texture_initialize (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:2175)
ERROR: Condition "texture.rd_texture.is_null()" is true.
   at: texture_2d_initialize (servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/texture_storage.cpp:1040)
```

3. Then errors from every later use of the missing textures. These made up the bulk of the flood:
```
ERROR: Attempting to use an uninitialized RID
   at: get_or_null (./core/templates/rid_owner.h:247)
ERROR: Parameter "tex" is null.
   at: texture_set_size_override / texture_set_path / texture_set_detect_3d_callback /
       texture_set_detect_normal_callback / texture_set_detect_roughness_callback / texture_2d_get
       (servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/texture_storage.cpp)
ERROR: Parameter "t" is null.
   at: texture_free (servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/texture_storage.cpp:965)
ERROR: Attempted to free invalid ID: 0
```

4. In the worst runs, drawing the editor itself started failing too:
```
ERROR: All attachments unused.
   at: framebuffer_create_multipass (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:3805)
ERROR: Parameter "framebuffer" is null.
   at: draw_list_begin (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:5685)
ERROR: Condition "!draw_list.active" is true.
   at: draw_list_bind_uniform_set (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:5913)
ERROR: Mismatch fragment shader output mask (1) and framebuffer color output mask (0) when binding both in render pipeline.
```

5. When the flood got too big for the editor's internal message queue:
```Failed method: EditorToaster::_error_handler_impl. Message queue out of memory. Try increasing 'memory/limits/message_queue/max_size_mb' in project settings.```
This line goes to the terminal only, not the Output panel. On unfixed builds, the crash came right after it.

That's a lot of RIDs, a lot of memory, this might be an issue of loading data that doesn't need to be loaded, but might also be a more practical limit, needs to be looked into further 

RID owners have a maximum allowed size which is relevant for performance and threading, and shouldn't be increased without good reason (thread-safe RID owners allocate their entire maximum size at the start to avoid locking, so even if they aren't all used the memory is still allocated), so would be important to identify if something else can be fixed here

Possibly related:
* https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/95979

I've done some exploration of this, and have some pretty significant improvements that keep the UI responsive with 80,000 images. 

If you want, try the following and give drop feedback:

- #124138
